parts.t: Houses with Suites for Sale in South Surrey

faq.q: How do I find a South Surrey lot's zone?
faq.a: On the Surrey side, look the lot up on the City's COSMOS map and read its zone in Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000; White Rock lots sit under White Rock Zoning Bylaw No. 2506, adopted June 27, 2024.

faq.q: How many homes can go on a South Surrey lot?
faq.a: In Surrey, inside the urban containment boundary, lots under 4,050 m² may hold 3 units (280 m² or less) or 4 units (larger), with up to 6 for some lots within 400 m of frequent bus service; units can include a secondary suite (capped at 40% of the principal dwelling) or a coach/garden suite (35–75 m², up to 120 m² on RA/R2/R2-O/R3 lots), and a houseplex is allowed only in the R3 zone with a lane or two road frontages.

faq.q: Does the Agricultural Land Reserve affect South Surrey land?
faq.a: Yes, on the east side near Hazelmere and the farm areas. On ALR land, the Agricultural Land Commission allows one main house up to 500 m² plus at most one additional home of 90 m² (parcels of 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha). Check a specific parcel's ALR status with the Commission.
